Check that a funder is still active before spending research time: funders close, change scope and move deadlines. Details below were last checked in August 2026 and may be out of date.

<span id="open-source-and-public-interest-technology-funders"></span>
== Open source and public-interest technology funders ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Funder
! Notes
|-
| NLnet Foundation
| European fund for open internet technology. A first proposal is capped at EUR 50,000, and its eligibility page states no categorical exclusions of persons or entities and no geographical restrictions, so a legal entity or sponsor was not required. Scope leans toward core internet and protocol infrastructure and general FOSS engineering. Calls have fixed deadlines; confirm which fund is currently open.
|-
| Sovereign Tech Fund
| German fund for open digital infrastructure. Looks for already-built, developer-facing infrastructure rather than prototypes or user-facing applications. Scored criteria include prevalence and expertise.
|-
| Mozilla Technology Fund
| Successor to the defunct MOSS program. Recent cycle themes have been AI-centric; check for an open call.
|-
| Media Democracy Fund
| Thematic fit for digital rights, but does not accept unsolicited applications; a warm referral is needed.
|}
